edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.mechanism: PSA screening can move some aggressive prostate cancers into a more treatable window, but it also finds many slow-growing tumors that inflate diagnosis without helping survival.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2018 Vernooij systematic review in BMJ Open already points to psa screening produces mixed findings across studies, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Subgroup differences, dose thresholds, and competing mechanisms likely explain why the literature does not settle into one clean direction.
